sections.Profile:
Mad World, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in May 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale, with artwork by Art Stenholm.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Original Theme, Adventure
sections.Design Team:
- Animation: Ted Zale
- Design: Ted Zale
- Mechanics: Ted Zale
- Concept: Ted Zale
- Art: Art Stenholm
